description:
Implement the WebSocket transport per RFC 8887.

- GET /ws upgrades to a WebSocket connection.
- Frame shape per RFC 8887: each WS message is a JSON object with '@type' = Request | Response | RequestError | StateChange | WebSocketPushEnable | WebSocketPushDisable.
- Request frames dispatch through jmap_server::Dispatcher like POST /jmap. Response frames echo back on the same connection.
- StateChange frames are pushed when push is enabled (WebSocketPushEnable handshake).
- Subprotocol: 'jmap'.

Use tokio-tungstenite (already in scaffold .1 deps). The axum::extract::ws path is the conventional way to upgrade a connection inside an axum handler.

## Acceptance

- A WebSocket client can open ws://localhost:<port>/ws with 'jmap' subprotocol
- Send a Request frame, receive a Response frame on the same socket
- After WebSocketPushEnable, server pushes StateChange frames matching SSE behavior
- WebSocketPushDisable stops the push
- cargo clippy / cargo test workspace clean

## Depends on .3 (MemoryBackend wiring); shares change-tracking infrastructure with .4 (SSE)
